summary: Solid delivery with strong modularity, clear error handling, and proper CI/CD integration. Minor gaps: (1) Resolve-LicenseStatus (line 95) doesn't explicitly null-check $License before using it, relies on implicit -contains behavior; (2) Invoke-LicenseCheck.ps1 doesn't validate non-empty parameter values; (3) run-act-tests.ps1 assumes local docker image with --pull=false but doesn't document this prerequisite. Defensive `@($rows)` wrapping (line 143) is harmless but suggests array-handling confusion. Workflow correctly uses pinned actions, minimal permissions, shell: pwsh. Functions are appropriately sized and testable. Clean, production-ready code needing minor validation hardening.
